ownership.quote: Microsoft Dev Box is a product within Microsoft Azure, offered and operated by Microsoft Corporation.

stage.note: Microsoft Dev Box is a product line of Microsoft Corporation (NASDAQ: MSFT), a public company; not independently funded. Card also notes the product is closed to new customers since 2025-11-01 and retiring 2028-09-18.

revenue.basis: Whole-company figure for Microsoft Corporation; Microsoft Dev Box's individual product revenue is not separately disclosed.

note: Microsoft Dev Box is a Microsoft Azure product, not an independent company; it has no separate funding/investor history. It is closed to new customers since 2025-11-01, entered a closing-down period 2026-09-14, and retires 2028-09-18 (Microsoft recommends Windows 365 as the successor). Revenue figure shown is for Microsoft Corporation as a whole, not the Dev Box product specifically, per the task's guidance for subsidiaries of public companies.
